job.title: Services Manager
job.description:
We're seeking an experienced Services Manager to take overall responsibility for the building services delivery on a major data centre development.

This is a senior project delivery position, overseeing the coordination and execution of all MEP services, ensuring packages are delivered safely, commercially and in line with programme requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the overall MEP services strategy and delivery across the project.
  • Lead design coordination, technical reviews, procurement and subcontractor engagement.
  • Oversee mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, fire protection and associated building services packages.
  • Manage interfaces between services trades, civil, structural and architectural teams.
  • Drive programme, cost, quality and safety performance across all services works.
  • Manage subcontractor performance, resources, procurement and commercial outcomes.
  • Lead services coordination meetings and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants and project stakeholders.
  • Oversee testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing and final handover.
  • Lead, mentor and develop the wider services delivery team.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years' experience in commercial construction, with significant building services delivery experience.
  • Proven track record managing large-scale, complex MEP packages.
  • Experience across hyperscale data centres, hospitals or other mission-critical environments.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and associated building services.
  • Commercially astute, with experience managing budgets, forecasting, procurement and subcontractor contracts.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and drive successful project outcomes.
  • Degree-qualified in Engineering, Construction Management or equivalent.

Take the lead on a major data centre development, working with an established project team and having the autonomy to influence delivery strategy, commercial performance and long-term project success.

job.title: Services Manager
job.description:
MCR are currently looking for an experienced Services Manager to play a leading role in the delivery of major hyperscale data centre developments in Melbourne.

Take the lead on complex building services packages, drive high-quality engineering delivery and play a pivotal role in delivering the critical infrastructure powering Australia's next generation of data centres.

From early design development and procurement through to construction, commissioning and handover, you'll be at the forefront of project delivery, working alongside experienced project leaders, engineers and specialist contractors.

You'll have the opportunity to influence key decisions, overcome complex engineering challenges and bring together multidisciplinary teams to deliver projects where precision, performance and quality are non-negotiable.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the MEP delivery strategy, taking responsibility for the successful execution of all building services packages.
  • Lead the delivery of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, fire protection, BMS and specialist infrastructure systems.
  • Drive design development, technical reviews and buildability assessments, ensuring designs are practical, coordinated and ready for construction.
  • Build and lead relationships with specialist subcontractors, consultants, suppliers and equipment manufacturers.
  • Drive procurement strategies and long-lead equipment requirements, ensuring critical materials and systems arrive in line with programme demands.
  • Maintain control of installation progress, construction sequencing and key delivery milestones.
  • Work hand-in-hand with construction and commissioning teams to ensure seamless integration, testing and final handover.
  • Proactively identify and resolve technical issues, design clashes and programme risks before they impact delivery.
  • Act as a key point of contact for clients, consultants and senior project stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

  • A proven track record as a Services Manager, MEP Manager or in a senior Building Services delivery position.
  • Experience delivering large-scale, complex construction projects with significant MEP infrastructure requirements.
  • Data centre experience would be highly advantageous, although candidates from pharmaceutical, healthcare, semiconductor, defence and major industrial projects are strongly encouraged.
  • Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical building services and the interfaces between critical systems.
  • Experience driving services packages from design development and procurement through to installation, testing and commissioning.

job.title: Commissioning Manager
job.description:
As Commissioning Manager, you will take the lead in driving the commissioning process from early planning and preparation through to integrated systems testing, operational readiness and final handover.

Working alongside the project delivery team, you'll bring together construction, engineering, specialist subcontractors and equipment vendors to ensure every system performs as intended. You'll have oversight of commissioning strategy, programme delivery and technical outcomes, helping turn complex engineering designs into fully operational data centre.


Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the end-to-end commissioning programme, setting the strategy, priorities and delivery milestones.
  • Drive commissioning activities across mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, fire protection, BMS, controls and other critical infrastructure systems.
  • Lead the progression through commissioning Levels 1-5, culminating in integrated systems testing (IST).
  • Establish commissioning methodologies, testing procedures, schedules and reporting frameworks to maintain control of project milestones.
  • Work closely with construction and engineering teams to ensure installations are technically complete and ready for testing.
  • Build strong relationships with specialist subcontractors, OEMs and equipment manufacturers, keeping commissioning activities aligned and on track.
  • Identify potential technical challenges, programme constraints and commissioning risks before they impact delivery.
  • Champion quality, performance testing and defect resolution, ensuring systems meet the required design specifications.
  • Act as a key point of contact for client representatives, consultants and project stakeholders during testing, witnessing and acceptance.
  • Drive the transition from construction completion through to operational readiness, documentation and final project handover.

What We're Looking For

  • A proven track record leading commissioning activities on large-scale, technically complex construction projects.
  • Experience within data centres, pharmaceutical, healthcare, semiconductor, industrial or other mission-critical environments.
  • A strong technical understanding of mechanical and electrical building services and the interfaces between critical systems.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering commissioning programmes, including Level 1-5 activities and integrated systems testing.
  • The ability to bring multidisciplinary teams together, influence delivery partners and maintain momentum against demanding project deadlines.
  • Ability to identifying risks, resolving technical challenges and maintaining commissioning quality.
  • Confidence engaging with clients, consultants, contractors and senior project leadership.

job.title: Managing Director, Asia
job.description:
Managing Director, Asia | Data Centre Contractor | Singapore

Two years ago this business didn't exist. Today it's a data centre contractor with a nine-figure turnover, operating across several APAC markets and contracting directly with one of the world's largest hyperscalers.

It has grown on a simple idea. Clients always deal with someone senior enough to make a decision on the spot, not a layer of middle management. The founders now want a Managing Director to carry that approach into the next stage of growth.

What the role involves

  • Owning and growing the core hyperscale relationship.
  • Winning new clients and bringing new work to quote across the region.
  • Working closely with the founder on the commercial side and alongside three operational and technical directors.
  • Building a leadership structure that runs without the founders day to day, as the business sets its sights on a global footprint.

There's no revenue target in year one. The focus is on keeping current revenue, bringing new clients on board and building a credible pipeline. You'll have real autonomy, with direct access to the founder for decisions above your approval level.

What you'll bring

  • Experience running a business or holding a senior commercial leadership role.
  • A background in the data centre construction and delivery space, whether with a contractor, a specialist subcontractor, a consultancy or a supply-chain partner working on live builds.
  • A track record with hyperscale clients, and an understanding of how projects are won, priced and delivered on site.
  • Client relationships and the credibility to attract strong people.
  • A commercial leaning, a strong communication style with senior hyperscale stakeholders and enthusiasm for regional travel.

Package
A strong base salary, reflecting the seniority of the role.

The role is based in Singapore with regular travel across the region. All conversations are confidential, so message me directly if you'd like to talk.

job.title: Senior PM / Project Director

This is a major greenfield project, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a large-scale programme and play a defining role in its successful delivery from the early stages through to completion.

Taking overall responsibility for project execution, you will lead across operations, commercial performance, programme, client relationships and the wider project team.

This is not simply about overseeing construction. It is about creating the structure, setting the standards and driving the performance required to deliver a complex, multi-building development successfully.

Working alongside an established management team, you will bring strong leadership, commercial discipline and a clear approach to project delivery. You will also play an important role in developing the people around you, strengthening the team and ensuring the right systems and processes are in place to support the programme.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take full accountability for the successful execution of the nine-building development.
  • Establish robust project controls, systems and processes that drive consistency, performance and accountability.
  • Provide direction across programme, commercial, contractual and operational activities.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client, ensuring expectations are managed and commitments are delivered.

  • Create a culture focused on quality, safety, collaboration and getting the job done right.

This is an opportunity for an established Project Director, or an ambitious Senior Project Manager ready to step into a broader leadership position, to take on a significant data centre development and make a lasting impact on its delivery.

job.title: Grid Connections Manager, APAC (Data Centres)
job.description:
Grid Connections Manager, APAC (Data Centres)
Singapore | Regional travel across APAC

Power decides whether a data centre site goes ahead. This role sits right at that point.

We’re working with a global data centre platform that is growing its pipeline across APAC. They need a hands-on power and grid specialist, based in Singapore, to take sites from the first conversation with the utility through to energisation.

This is for someone who wants to do the work, not just oversee it. You’ll have consultants to support you, but you’ll be the person who knows the grid, talks to the utility and keeps the connection moving.

What you’ll do

  • Run power due diligence when new sites come up, engaging the utility and directing consultants to confirm capacity and timelines.
  • Own grid connection applications, technical studies and connection agreements with transmission and distribution operators.
  • Work on PPAs and other power contracts alongside the legal and commercial teams.
  • Be the main point of contact with grid operators on your projects.
  • Work with development, engineering, construction, legal and country teams so grid delivery is built into the wider programme.
  • Track grid risks and milestones from capacity reservation to energisation, and raise issues early with clear options.
  • Help build repeatable processes as the APAC programme scales.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on experience of grid connection or power infrastructure delivery, from application through to connection agreement, and ideally energisation.
  • Direct knowledge of at least one or two APAC grids and their utility processes, with skills that carry across markets.
  • Enough technical grounding in HV and MV connections and grid codes to hold your own with utilities and engineers, plus the commercial sense to handle connection contracts and PPAs.
  • Experience working across engineering, construction, legal and commercial teams.
  • A degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Willingness to travel across the region as projects need, at times up to 30%.

Backgrounds from data centre developers, renewables or battery storage developers, utilities and network operators are all relevant. Experience on 100MW+ connections, or a second Asian language, would be an advantage.

Interested? Apply here or message Ben Ross at Mission Critical Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Commissioning Manager
job.description:
Commissioning Manager
Johor, Malaysia
160-200k SGD / 500-635k MYR Annual

Our client, a global engineering business with a dedicated critical facilities commissioning team, needs an experienced Commissioning Manager to lead contractor-side commissioning on a 200MW+ data centre in Johor for a large global data centre provider.

This is a fast-paced build and the role is broad. You will own commissioning from L1 to L5 and integrated systems testing, manage the commissioning engineers and leads on site, and be the person the General Contractor, the end client and the supply chain rely on to get the facility handed over to the client's global standards. It suits an all-rounder with real depth in both power and cooling, rather than a single-discipline specialist.

What you'll be doing

  • Building the commissioning strategy, plan and programme from the contract documents and Employer's Requirements
  • Running commission-ability reviews and flagging scope and design issues early to the design and project teams
  • Witnessing Factory Acceptance Tests and developing SAT and IST scripts, method statements and risk assessments
  • Managing day-to-day commissioning on site, including the commissioning team, subcontractors and supply chain
  • Reporting to and engaging directly with the client and contractors, and presenting strategy to senior stakeholders
  • Leading lessons learnt and feeding improvements back into company commissioning standards

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years in data centre infrastructure across power and cooling
  • Experience leading commissioning from L1 to L5 and IST on large-scale data centre builds, ideally on the contractor or commissioning agent side
  • Experience leading a team of commissioning engineers and leads
  • A mechanical or electrical engineering degree, or similar
  • Working knowledge of BSRIA, ASHRAE and CIBSE methods. Uptime Tiers and TIA-942 knowledge is useful but not essential
  • Based in Malaysia or Singapore, or already in the region and open to Johor, with a willingness to travel regionally

The package

  • 10% bonus
  • Overtime paid at time-and-a-half or double time
  • Permanent role
